title: Sukta 1 · On the preparation and use of holy water, with, a prayer for purification and freedom from sin
deity: On the preparation and use of holy water, with, a prayer for purification and freedom from sin
text:
दुःखमोचनम्।
१-१३ अथर्वा। प्रजापतिः (नव पर्यायाः)। १, ३ द्विपदा साम्नी बृहती, २, १० याजुषी त्रिष्टुप्,
४ आसुरी गायत्री, ५, ८ साम्नी पङ्क्तिः (५ द्विपदा), ६ साम्नी अनुष्टुप्, ७ निचृद् विराड् गायत्री,
९ आसुरी पङ्क्तिः, ११ साम्नी उष्णिक्, १२-१३ आर्ची अनुष्टुप्।
अति॑सृष्टो अ॒पां वृ॑ष॒भोऽति॑सृष्टा अ॒ग्नयो॑ दि॒व्याः ॥१॥
रु॒जन् प॑रिरु॒जन् मृ॒णन् प्र॑मृ॒णन्॥२॥
म्रो॒को म॑नो॒हा ख॒नो नि॑र्दा॒ह आ॑त्म॒दूषि॑स्तनू॒दूषिः॑ ॥३॥
इ॒दं तमति॑ सृजामि॒ तं माभ्यव॑निक्षि ॥४॥
तेन॒ तम॒भ्यति॑सृजामो॒ यो॒३ऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि॒ यं व॒यं द्वि॒ष्मः ॥५॥
अ॒पामग्र॑मसि समु॒द्रं वो॒ऽभ्यव॑सृजामि॥६॥
यो॒३प्स्व॑१ग्निरति॒ तं सृ॑जामि म्रो॒कं ख॒निं त॑नू॒दूषि॑म्॥७॥
यो व॑ आपो॒ऽग्निरा॑वि॒वेश॒ स ए॒ष यद् वो॑ घो॒रं तदे॒तत्॥८॥
इन्द्र॑स्य व इन्द्रि॒येणा॒भि षि॑ञ्चेत्॥९॥
अ॒रि॒प्रा आपो॑ अप॑ रि॒प्रम॒स्मत्॥१०॥
प्रास्मदेनो॑ वहन्तु॒ प्र दु॒ष्वप्न्यं॑ वहन्तु ॥११॥
शि॒वेन॑ मा॒ चक्षु॑षा पश्यतापः शि॒वया॑ त॒न्वोप॑ स्पृशत॒ त्वचं॑ मे ॥१२॥
शि॒वान॒ग्नीन॑प्सु॒षदो॑ हवामहे॒ मयि॑ क्ष॒त्रं वर्च॒ आ ध॑त्त देवीः ॥१३॥
translation_en:
The Bull of the Waters hath been let go; the heavenly fires have been let go.

Breaking, breaking down, crushing, crushing to pieces,

Mroka, mind-destroying, rooting up, consuming, ruiner of the soul, ruiner of the body.

Here I let him go: thou washest me clean of him.

With this we let him loose who hates us and whom we hate.

Thou art in front of the waters. I let loose your sea.

I let loose the Agni who is within the waters, Mroka the up- rooter, the destroyer of the body.

Your Agni who entered into the waters, even he here is that very dread of yours.

May he anoint you with Indra's own mighty power!

May stainless waters cleanse us from defilement.

May they carry sin away from us, may they carry away from us the evil dream.

Look on me with a friendly eye, O, Waters, and touch my skin with your auspicious body.

We call the gracious Fires that dwell in waters. Goddesses, grant me princely power and splendour.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 1 · On the preparation and use of holy water, with, a prayer for purification and freedom from sin - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा On the preparation and use of holy water, with, a prayer for purification and freedom from sin की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [On the preparation and use of holy water, with, a prayer for purification and freedom from sin स्तुति]: The Bull of the Waters hath been let go; the heavenly fires have been let go.

2. [On the preparation and use of holy water, with, a prayer for purification and freedom from sin स्तुति]: Breaking, breaking down, crushing, crushing to pieces,

3. [On the preparation and use of holy water, with, a prayer for purification and freedom from sin स्तुति]: Mroka, mind-destroying, rooting up, consuming, ruiner of the soul, ruiner of the body.

4. [On the preparation and use of holy water, with, a prayer for purification and freedom from sin स्तुति]: Here I let him go: thou washest me clean of him.

5. [On the preparation and use of holy water, with, a prayer for purification and freedom from sin स्तुति]: With this we let him loose who hates us and whom we hate.

6. [On the preparation and use of holy water, with, a prayer for purification and freedom from sin स्तुति]: Thou art in front of the waters. I let loose your sea.

7. [On the preparation and use of holy water, with, a prayer for purification and freedom from sin स्तुति]: I let loose the Agni who is within the waters, Mroka the up- rooter, the destroyer of the body.

8. [On the preparation and use of holy water, with, a prayer for purification and freedom from sin स्तुति]: Your Agni who entered into the waters, even he here is that very dread of yours.

9. [On the preparation and use of holy water, with, a prayer for purification and freedom from sin स्तुति]: May he anoint you with Indra's own mighty power!

10. [On the preparation and use of holy water, with, a prayer for purification and freedom from sin स्तुति]: May stainless waters cleanse us from defilement.

11. [On the preparation and use of holy water, with, a prayer for purification and freedom from sin स्तुति]: May they carry sin away from us, may they carry away from us the evil dream.

12. [On the preparation and use of holy water, with, a prayer for purification and freedom from sin स्तुति]: Look on me with a friendly eye, O, Waters, and touch my skin with your auspicious body.

13. [On the preparation and use of holy water, with, a prayer for purification and freedom from sin स्तुति]: We call the gracious Fires that dwell in waters. Goddesses, grant me princely power and splendour.

title: Sukta 2 · A charm to secure various blessings
deity: A charm to secure various blessings
text:
१-६ अथर्वा। वाक्। १ आसुरी अनुष्टुप्, २ आसुरी उष्णिक्, ३ साम्नी उष्णिक्,
४ त्रिपदा साम्नी बृहती, ५ आर्ची अनुष्टुप्, ६ निचृद् विराड् गायत्री।

निर्दु॑रर्म॒ण्य ऊ॒र्जा मधु॑मती॒ वाक्॥१॥
मधु॑मती स्थ॒ मधु॑मतीं॒ वाच॑मुदेयम्॥२॥
उप॑हूतो मे गो॒पाः उप॑हूतो गोपी॒थः ॥३॥
सु॒श्रुतौ॒ कर्णौ॑ भद्र॒श्रुतौ॒ कर्णौ॑ भ॒द्रं श्लोकं॑ श्रूयासम्॥४॥
सुश्रु॑तिश्च॒ मोप॑श्रुतिश्च॒ मा हा॑सिष्टां॒ सौप॑र्णं॒ चक्षु॒रज॑स्रं॒ ज्योतिः॑ ॥५॥
ऋषी॑णां प्रस्त॒रोऽसि॒ नमो॑ऽस्तु दैवा॑य प्रस्त॒राय॑ ॥६॥
translation_en:
Away from distasteful food, strength and sweet speech,

Are pleasant. May I obtain a pleasant voice.

I have invoked the Protector; I have invoked his protection.

Quick of hearing are mine ears; mine ears hear what is good- Fain would I hear a pleasant sound.

Let not good hearing and overhearing fail the Eagle's eye, the undecaying light.

Thou art the couch of the Rishis. Let worship be paid to the divine couch.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 2 · A charm to secure various blessings - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm to secure various blessings की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm to secure various blessings स्तुति]: Away from distasteful food, strength and sweet speech,

2. [A charm to secure various blessings स्तुति]: Are pleasant. May I obtain a pleasant voice.

3. [A charm to secure various blessings स्तुति]: I have invoked the Protector; I have invoked his protection.

4. [A charm to secure various blessings स्तुति]: Quick of hearing are mine ears; mine ears hear what is good- Fain would I hear a pleasant sound.

5. [A charm to secure various blessings स्तुति]: Let not good hearing and overhearing fail the Eagle's eye, the undecaying light.

6. [A charm to secure various blessings स्तुति]: Thou art the couch of the Rishis. Let worship be paid to the divine couch.

title: Sukta 3 · A charm to secure power and long life
deity: A charm to secure power and long life
text:
१-६ ब्रह्मा।आदित्यः। १ आसुरी गायत्री, २-३ आर्ची अनुष्टुप्, ४ प्राजापत्या त्रिष्टुप्,
५ साम्नी उष्णिक्, ६ द्विपदा साम्नी त्रिष्टुप्।

मू॒र्धाहं र॑यी॒णां मू॒र्धा स॑मा॒नानां॑ भूयासम्॥१॥
रु॒जश्च॑ मा वे॒नश्च॒ मा हा॑सिष्टां मू॒र्धा च॑ मा॒ विध॑र्मा च॒ मा हा॑सिष्टाम्॥२॥
उ॒र्वश्च॑ मा चम॒सश्च॒ मा हा॑सिष्टां ध॒र्ता च॑ मा ध॒रुण॑श्च॒ मा हा॑सिष्टाम्॥३॥
वि॒मो॒कश्च॑ मा॒र्द्रप॑विश्च॒ मा हा॑सिष्टामा॒र्द्रदा॑नुश्च मा मात॒रिश्वा॑ च॒ मा हा॑सिष्टाम्॥४॥
बृह॒स्पति॑र्म आ॒त्मा नृ॒मणा॒ नाम॒ हृद्यः॑ ॥५॥
अ॒सं॒ता॒पं मे॒ हृद॑यमु॒र्वी गव्यू॑तिः समु॒द्रो अ॑स्मि॒ विध॑र्मणा ॥६॥
translation_en:
I am the head of riches. Fain would I be the head of mine equals.

Let not Ruja and Vena desert me. Let not the Head and the Preserver forsake me.

Let not the Boiler and the Cup fail tme: let not the Supporter and the Sustainer abandon me.

Let not Unyoking and the Moist-fellied car desert me: let not the Sender of Moisture and Matarisvan forsake me.

Brihaspati is my soul, he who is called the Friend of man, dear to my heart.

My heart is free from sorrow; spacious is my dwelling-place. I am the sea in capacity.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 3 · A charm to secure power and long life - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm to secure power and long life की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm to secure power and long life स्तुति]: I am the head of riches. Fain would I be the head of mine equals.

2. [A charm to secure power and long life स्तुति]: Let not Ruja and Vena desert me. Let not the Head and the Preserver forsake me.

3. [A charm to secure power and long life स्तुति]: Let not the Boiler and the Cup fail tme: let not the Supporter and the Sustainer abandon me.

4. [A charm to secure power and long life स्तुति]: Let not Unyoking and the Moist-fellied car desert me: let not the Sender of Moisture and Matarisvan forsake me.

5. [A charm to secure power and long life स्तुति]: Brihaspati is my soul, he who is called the Friend of man, dear to my heart.

6. [A charm to secure power and long life स्तुति]: My heart is free from sorrow; spacious is my dwelling-place. I am the sea in capacity.

title: Sukta 4 · A charm to secure long life and success
deity: A charm to secure long life and success
text:
१-७ ब्रह्मा। आदित्यः,। १,३ साम्नी अनुष्टुप्, २ साम्नी उष्णिक्, ४ त्रिपदा अनुष्टुप्,
५ आसुरी गायत्री, ६ आर्ची उष्णिक्, ७ त्रिपदा विराड् गर्भाऽनुष्टुप्।

नाभि॑र॒हं र॑यी॒णां नाभिः॑ समा॒नानां॑ भूयासम्॥१॥
स्वा॒सद॑सि सू॒षा अ॒मृतो॒ मर्त्ये॒श्वा॥२॥
मा मां प्रा॒णो हा॑सी॒न्मो अ॑पा॒नोऽव॒हाय॒ परा॑ गात्॥३॥
सूर्यो॒ माह्नः॑ पात्व॒ग्निः पृ॑थि॒व्या वा॒युर॒न्तरि॑क्षाद् य॒मो म॑नु॒ष्येऽभ्यः॒ सर॑स्वती॒ पार्थि॑वेभ्यः ॥४॥
प्राणा॑पानौ॒ मा मा॑ हासिष्टं॒ मा जने॒ प्र मे॑षि ॥५॥
स्व॒स्त्य॑१द्योषसो॑ दो॒षस॑श्च॒ सर्व॑ आपः॒ सर्व॑गणो अशीय ॥६॥
शक्व॑री स्थ प॒शवो॑ मोप॑ स्थेषुर्मि॒त्रावरु॑णौ मे प्राणापा॒नाव॒ग्निर्मे॒ दक्षं॑ दधातु ॥७॥
translation_en:
I am the:centre of riches. Fain would I be the centre of mine equals.

Pleasant art thou to sit by one, a mother: immortal among mortals.

Let not inward breath desert me; let not outward breath depart and leave me.

Let Sūrya protect me from Day, Agni from Earth, Vāyu from Firmament, Yama from men, Sarasvatī from dwellers on the earth.

Let not outward and inward breath fail me. Be not thou destruc- tive among the men.

Propitious to-day be dawns and evenings. May I drink water with all my people safe around me.

Mighty are ye, domestic creatures. May Mitra-Varuna stand beside me. May Agni give me inward and outward breath. May,he give me ability.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 4 · A charm to secure long life and success - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm to secure long life and success की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm to secure long life and success स्तुति]: I am the:centre of riches. Fain would I be the centre of mine equals.

2. [A charm to secure long life and success स्तुति]: Pleasant art thou to sit by one, a mother: immortal among mortals.

3. [A charm to secure long life and success स्तुति]: Let not inward breath desert me; let not outward breath depart and leave me.

4. [A charm to secure long life and success स्तुति]: Let Sūrya protect me from Day, Agni from Earth, Vāyu from Firmament, Yama from men, Sarasvatī from dwellers on the earth.

5. [A charm to secure long life and success स्तुति]: Let not outward and inward breath fail me. Be not thou destruc- tive among the men.

6. [A charm to secure long life and success स्तुति]: Propitious to-day be dawns and evenings. May I drink water with all my people safe around me.

7. [A charm to secure long life and success स्तुति]: Mighty are ye, domestic creatures. May Mitra-Varuna stand beside me. May Agni give me inward and outward breath. May,he give me ability.

title: Sukta 5 · A charm against evil dreams
text:
१-१० यमः। दुःष्वप्ननाशनम्। १-६ (प्रथमा) विराड् गायत्री ५ (प्रथमा) भुरिक्, ६(प्रथमा) स्वराट्,
१-६ (द्वितीया) प्राजापत्या गायत्री, १-६ (तृतीय) द्विपदा साम्नी बृहती।

वि॒द्म ते॑ स्वप्न ज॒नित्रं॒ ग्राह्याः॑ पु॒त्रोऽसि य॒मस्य॒ कर॑णः ॥१॥
अन्त॑कोऽसि मृ॒त्युर॑सि ॥२॥
तं त्वा॑ स्वप्न॒ तथा॒ सं वि॑द्म॒ स नः॑ स्वप्न दु॒ष्वप्न्या॑त् पाहि ॥३॥
वि॒द्म ते॑ स्वप्न ज॒नित्रं॒ निरृ॑त्याः पु॒त्रोऽसि य॒मस्य॒ कर॑णः ।
अन्त॑कोऽसि मृ॒त्युर॑सि । तं त्वा॑ स्वप्न॒ तथा॒ सं वि॑द्म॒ स नः॑ स्वप्न दु॒ष्वप्न्या॑त् पाहि ॥४॥
वि॒द्म ते॑ स्वप्न ज॒नित्र॒मभू॑त्याः पु॒त्रोऽसि य॒मस्य॒ कर॑णः ।
अन्त॑कोऽसि मृ॒त्युर॑सि । तं त्वा॑ स्वप्न॒ तथा॒ सं वि॑द्म॒ स नः॑ स्वप्न दु॒ष्वप्न्या॑त् पाहि ॥५॥
वि॒द्म ते॑ स्वप्न ज॒नित्रं॒ निर्भू॑त्याः पु॒त्रोऽसि य॒मस्य॒ कर॑णः ।
अन्त॑कोऽसि मृ॒त्युर॑सि । तं त्वा॑ स्वप्न॒ तथा॒ सं वि॑द्म॒ स नः॑ स्वप्न दु॒ष्वप्न्या॑त् पाहि ॥६॥
वि॒द्म ते॑ स्वप्न ज॒नित्रं॒ परा॑भूत्याः पु॒त्रोऽसि य॒मस्य॒ कर॑णः ।
अन्त॒कोऽसि मृ॒त्युर॑सि । तं त्वा॑ स्वप्न॒ तथा॒ सं वि॑द्म॒ स नः॑ स्वप्न दु॒ष्वप्न्या॑त् पाहि ॥७॥
वि॒द्म ते॑ स्वप्न ज॒नित्रं॑ देवजामी॒नां पु॒त्रोऽसि य॒मस्य॒ कर॑णः ॥८॥
अन्त॑कोऽसि मृ॒त्युर॑सि ॥९॥
तं त्वा॑ स्वप्न॒ तथा॒ सं वि॑द्म॒ स नः॑ स्वप्न दु॒ष्वप्न्या॑त् पाहि ॥१०॥
translation_en:
We know thine origin, O Sleep. Thou art the son of Grahi, the minister of Yama. Thou art the Ender, thou art Death. As such, O Sleep, we know thee well. As such preserve us from the evil dream.

We know thine origin, O Sleep. Thou art the son of Destruction, the minister of Yama, etc. (as in verse 1).

We know thine origin, O Sleep. Thou art the son of Misery, etc.

We know thine origin, O Sleep. Thou art the son of Disappear- ance, etc.

We know thine origin, O Sleep. Thou art the son of Defeat etc.

We know thine origin, O Sleep. Thou art the son of the sisters of the Gods, the minister of Yama. Thou art the Ender, thou are Death. As such, O Sleep, we know thee well. As such, preserve us from the evil dream.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 5 · A charm against evil dreams - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm against evil dreams की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm against evil dreams स्तुति]: We know thine origin, O Sleep. Thou art the son of Grahi, the minister of Yama. Thou art the Ender, thou art Death. As such, O Sleep, we know thee well. As such preserve us from the evil dream.

2. [A charm against evil dreams स्तुति]: We know thine origin, O Sleep. Thou art the son of Destruction, the minister of Yama, etc. (as in verse 1).

3. [A charm against evil dreams स्तुति]: We know thine origin, O Sleep. Thou art the son of Misery, etc.

4. [A charm against evil dreams स्तुति]: We know thine origin, O Sleep. Thou art the son of Disappear- ance, etc.

5. [A charm against evil dreams स्तुति]: We know thine origin, O Sleep. Thou art the son of Defeat etc.

Evil day-dream, evil dream in sleep,

Wishes for boons that will not come, thoughts of poverty, the snares of the Druh who never releases.

This, O Agni, let the Gods bear off to Such-an-one that he may be a fragile good-for-nothing eunuch.

यो॒३स्मान् द्वेष्टि॒ तमा॒त्मा द्वे॑ष्टु॒ यं व॒यं द्वि॒ष्मः स आ॒त्मानं॑ द्वेष्टु ॥५॥
निर्द्वि॒षन्तं॑ दि॒वो निः पृ॑थि॒व्या निर॒न्तरि॑क्षाद् भजाम ॥६॥
सुया॑मंश्चाक्षुष ॥७॥
इ॒दम॒हमा॑मुष्याय॒णे॒३मुष्याः॑ पु॒त्रे दु॒ष्वप्न्यं॑ मृजे ॥८॥
यद॒दोअ॑दो अ॒भ्यग॑च्छन् यद् दो॒षा यत् पूर्वां॒ रात्रि॑म्॥९॥
यज्जाग्र॑द् यत् सु॒प्तो यद् दिवा॒ यन्नक्त॑म्॥१०॥
यदह॑रहरभि॒गच्छा॑मि॒ तस्मा॑देन॒मव॑ दये ॥११॥
तं ज॑हि॒ तेन॑ मन्दस्व॒ तस्य॑ पृ॒ष्टीरपि॑ शृणीहि ॥१२॥
स मा जी॑वी॒त् तं प्रा॒णो ज॑हातु ॥१३॥
translation_en:
Herewith I pierce this man. With poverty I pierce him. With disappearance I pierce him. With defeat I pierce him. With Grāhi I pierce him. With darkness I pierce him.

I summon him with the awful cruel orders of the Gods.

I place him between Vaisvānara's jaws.

Thus or otherwise let her swallow him up.

Him who hates us may his soul hate, and may he whom we hate hate himself.

We scorch out of heaven and earth and firmament the man who hates us.

Suyāman son of Chakshus.

Here I wipe away the evil dream on the descendant of Such-an- one, son of Such-a-woman.

Whatsoever I have met with, whether at dusk or during early night,

Whether waking or sleeping, whether by day or by night.

Whether I meet with it day by day, from that do I bribe him away.

Slay him; rejoice in this; crush his ribs.

Let him not live. Let the breath of life forsake him.

title: Sukta 9 · A charm to secure wealth and felicity
deity: A charm to secure wealth and felicity
text:
१-४ यमः। १ प्रजापतिः, २ अग्निः, सोमः, पूषा, ३-४ सूर्यः। प्राजापत्या आर्च्यनुष्टुप्,
२ आर्च्युष्णिक्, ३ साम्नी पङ्क्तिः, ४ परोष्णिक्।

जि॒तम॒स्माक॒मुद्भि॑न्नम॒स्माक॑म॒भ्यऽष्ठां॒ विश्वाः॒ पृत॑ना॒ अरा॑तीः ॥१॥
तद॒ग्निरा॑ह॒ तदु॒ सोम॑ आह पू॒षा मा॑ धात् सुकृ॒तस्य॑ लो॒के॥२॥
अग॑न्म॒ स्वः॑१ स्वऽरगन्म॒ सं सूर्य॑स्य॒ ज्यो॑ति॑षागन्म ॥३॥
व॒स्यो॒भूया॑य॒ वसु॑मान् य॒ज्ञो वसु॑ वंसिषीय॒ वसु॑मान् भूयासं॒ वसु॒ मयि॑ धेहि ॥४॥
translation_en:
Ours is superior place and ours is conquest: may I in all fights tread down spite and malice.

This word hath Agni, this hath Soma spoken. May Pūshan set me in the world of virtue.

We have come to the light of heaven; to the light of heaven have we come: we have united with the light of Surya.

Sacrifice is fraught with wealth for the increase of prosperity. I would win riches; fain would I be wealthy. Do thou bestow wealth upon me.
